# Perks still to wire

**Implementation instructions live in `docs/plans/PERK_WIRING_PLAN.md`.**
This document is only the inventory: which perks, in which batch, saying what.

8 of 603 perks are wired in data. 138 more work through
a hand-written `has_perk` check somewhere in the combat code — those function, but
each is a bespoke `if` rather than data, which is why the rest were never done.

A perk leaves this document when it carries an `effects` block (passive) or a
`combat_data` block (active), so the counts are the progress bar.

## Two different fields, deliberately

**Active perks** — description begins with `Active` — take a **`combat_data`**
block. `scripts/combat/combat_arena.gd` already implements the whole pipeline for
them: the button, stamina, cooldowns, weapon requirements, targeting, eight effect
types and AI usage scoring. Not one perk carries `combat_data`, so all of it is
unused. These are data work against working code, which makes them the cheapest
batch, not the hardest.

**Everything else** takes an **`effects`** block typed against
`resources/data/perk_effects.json`. Do not merge the two — `combat_data` works
today and folding it into the registry would break it for tidiness.

## `multi_arm` — 2 perks

Body-plan specific, handled by BodySystem. Small and self-contained.

- **`akimbo`** ( 0 · hand-wired)  
  Passive. All secondary arm attack chances in the multi-arm chain are increased by +20% (e.g. off-hand chance 50%→70% at Finesse 10).
- **`coordinated_strikes`** ( 0 · hand-wired)  
  Passive (multi-arm species only). If an arm in the attack chain kills its target, reset the chain — the next arm rolls independently rather than stopping.

## `combat_reactions` — 13 perks

Reactions and the space around a unit — zone of control, opportunity attacks, blocking, retaliation. The hook is in movement and the attack resolution order, not in stats.

- **`dont_lose_the_momentum`** (swords 4)  
  Passive. While you successfully parried last turn, sword attacks cost 1 less Stamina and your Parry threshold is treated as 5% higher.

  When an enemy enters your reach (2 tiles), make a free reaction attack (once per enemy per round).

  Your zone-of-control reaction attacks Slow enemies for 1 turn. While you did not move this turn, your spear's reach extends by 1 tile.
- **`improved_parry`** (swords 7 · hand-wired)  
  Passive. 40% of your Attack is added to Armor. Parry applies against the first melee hit each round even if flanked.
- **`long_memory`** (spears 1)  
  Reaction attacks (from First to Strike, Set for Charge, etc.) gain +15% damage.
- **`no_one_left_behind`** (leadership 5 · hand-wired)  
  Allies below 30% HP gain +20% Armor and +20% healing received. Allies who disengage or reposition do not provoke opportunity attacks.
- **`opportunist_daggers`** (daggers 7)

- **`phalanx_fighter`** (martial_combinations )  
  While wielding a spear and shield, allies adjacent to you gain +15% Armor. Your spear reaction attacks also trigger when adjacent allies are targeted by melee attacks.
- **`riposte`** (swords 5 · hand-wired)  
  Passive trigger. When you successfully Dodge or Parry a melee attack, your next sword attack costs 2 less Stamina and gains +25% damage.
- **`the_blade_decides`** (swords 9)

- **`the_line_holds`** (spears 10)

- **`the_water_finds_the_crack`** (grace 10)

- **`tower_shield`** (armor 6)

  Passive. Each turn, the first ranged attack that hits grants an immediate second shot at −25% damage against the same target or one adjacent to it.
- **`the_universe_loves_a_good_joke`** (comedy 9)  
  Once per combat, force a reroll of any single failed roll and take the better result.
- **`the_whole_arc`** (axes 10)  
  Passive. Axe kills no longer end your momentum — momentum stacks persist through a kill and carry into the next turn. At 5+ stacks, every axe hit cleaves one adjacent enemy for full damage.
- **`thousand_cuts`** (daggers 10)  
  Passive. Every dagger hit on a target that is already Bleeding refreshes and deepens the bleed instead of reapplying it (stacking to 5). At 5 stacks the target takes double bleed damage and cannot be healed above half HP.
- **`too_fast_to_count`** (daggers 9 · hand-wired)  
  Once per turn, your first dagger attack is a guaranteed hit.
- **`undead_hunter`** (earth_magic 3 · hand-wired)  
  Passive. You are immune to diseases inflicted by undead or diseased enemies' attacks.
- **`welltempered`** (might 6)  
  Passive. Crowd control effects on you last 1 fewer turn (minimum 1).
- **`where_there_is_smoke`** (fire_magic 9)  
  Smoke areas deal 3 fire damage per turn and have a 20% chance per turn to ignite (become burning terrain).
- **`wide_arc`** (axes 3 · hand-wired)  
  Axe attacks deal 50% damage to one adjacent enemy.
- **`zazouken`** (guile 9)  
  False images now attack adjacent enemies for 30% of your damage. Still 1 HP.


---

Classification is a regex reading of the prose, not something the data asserts.
It is right often enough to size and group the work; it will be wrong on
individual perks, which is why every description is printed above.
